title: Communications
about: Letters, email and phones: the words for the things we use, and simple phrases for a phone call, like 'Can I speak to …?' and 'I'll call back later'.

parts.title: Saying numbers and email addresses
parts.note: Номер телефону читають по одній цифрі, з короткими паузами між групами. Нуль у номері британці зазвичай читають oh (як літеру O), можна й zero. Дві однакові цифри поспіль — double: 77 — double seven. В адресі електронної пошти @ читається at, крапка — dot, а .com — /kɒm/. Короткі частини з літер читають по літері: .uk — U-K.

rows: oh nine three, double five two, one eight four oh
max dot bond at mail dot com
anna at post dot co dot U-K

items.pattern: write / send / get a letter (to sb)
items.meaning: a message on paper that you send to someone
items.example: My grandma still writes me a **letter** every month.
more: We got a **letter** from the school about the new timetable.
Can you help me write a **letter** to my teacher?
items.watchOut: Letter — і «лист», і «літера» (the letter A). Лист на дереві — це leaf.

items.pattern: your address · write the address on sth
items.meaning: the house number, street and town where someone lives
items.example: Write your **address** clearly so the parcel arrives.
more: What's your new **address**?
I don't know her **address**, but I know her street.
items.watchOut: Пишеться з двома d і двома s: address. У британській англійській наголос зазвичай на другому складі: /əˈdres/.

items.pattern: the date · write the date · What's the date today?
items.meaning: the day, month and year
items.example: I always forget the **date** of my cousin's birthday.
more: Write the **date** at the top of your letter.
What **date** is the school concert?
items.watchOut: «Яке сьогодні число?» — What's the date today?, а не What number is today.

items.pattern: put sth in an envelope · on the envelope
items.meaning: a paper cover that you put a letter or card in
items.example: She put the birthday card in a pink **envelope**.
more: Mum keeps old photos in a big brown **envelope**.
There's some money in this **envelope** for your school trip.
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: /ˈenvələʊp/. Перед словом — an: an envelope.

items.pattern: put a stamp on sth · buy stamps
items.meaning: a small piece of paper you buy and stick on a letter to send it
items.example: I need a **stamp** for this postcard.
more: Don't forget to put a **stamp** on the card.
You can buy **stamps** at the post office.
items.watchOut: Марка — stamp, а не mark. Mark — це оцінка або пляма.

items.pattern: put sth in the letter box · through the letter box
items.meaning: a box in the street where you put letters to send them; also the hole in a front door for letters
items.example: I put your card in the **letter box** this morning.
more: Is there a **letter box** near here? I need to post this.
Our dog barks every time something comes through the **letter box**.
items.watchOut: Скринька на вулиці у Британії — letter box або postbox. Отвір у дверях для пошти — теж letter box. Американці кажуть mailbox.

items.pattern: post a letter / a card (to sb)
items.meaning: send a letter or card: put it in a letter box or take it to the post office
items.example: I **posted** the invitations on Monday.
more: Grandma **posted** me a book for my birthday.
Did you **post** the card to Aunt Olga?
items.watchOut: Британською — post a letter, американською — mail a letter. Пошта (будівля) — the post office.

items.pattern: use a computer · on the computer
items.meaning: a machine that helps you write, play games, keep photos and find information
items.example: My brother does his homework on the **computer**.
more: We've got two new **computers** in the school library.
Dad is on the **computer** again.
items.watchOut: Працювати, грати, робити щось на комп'ютері — on the computer: I do my homework on the computer. Наголос на другому складі: /kəmˈpjuːtə/.

items.pattern: on the screen · a big / small screen
items.meaning: the flat glass part of a computer, phone or TV where you see pictures and words
items.example: Don't sit too close to the **screen**. It's bad for your eyes.
more: We watched the match on a big **screen** in the park.
Clean the **screen** with a soft cloth.
items.watchOut: На екрані — on the screen: The answer is on the screen.

items.pattern: type on the keyboard · the keys on the keyboard
items.meaning: the part of a computer with letters and numbers that you press
items.example: I spilt juice on my **keyboard**, and now the letter E doesn't work.
more: This **keyboard** has Ukrainian and English letters.
Your **keyboard** is dirty. Clean it with a dry cloth.
items.watchOut: Keyboard — ще й електронне піаніно, синтезатор: She plays the keyboard.

items.pattern: move / click the mouse · a computer mouse
items.meaning: a small thing you move with your hand to choose things on a computer screen
items.example: Move the **mouse** and click on the picture.
more: The battery in my **mouse** is flat.
Grandma doesn't use a **mouse**. She touches the screen.
items.watchOut: Множина — mice: one mouse, two mice. Про комп'ютерні мишки іноді кажуть і mouses.

items.pattern: on my laptop · carry a laptop
items.meaning: a small computer you can carry and use anywhere
items.example: Mum takes her **laptop** on the train and works there.
more: I watch films on my **laptop** in bed.
Is your **laptop** in your school bag?
items.watchOut: Ноутбук — laptop. Notebook англійською — зошит або блокнот.

items.pattern: put sth on a memory stick · on my memory stick
items.meaning: a very small thing you put into a computer to keep files and photos
items.example: I've got all my holiday photos on this **memory stick**.
more: My **memory stick** is so small that I always lose it.
I can't find my **memory stick**. Is it in the computer?
items.watchOut: «Флешка» — memory stick, USB stick або flash drive. Просто flash — це спалах фотоапарата.

items.pattern: send / get an email · email sb (sth)
items.meaning: a message you send from one computer or phone to another
items.example: I got an **email** from my teacher about the school trip.
more: Can you send me an **email** with the photos?
I'll **email** you the details tonight.
items.watchOut: Email — і іменник (an email), і дієслово (email sb): I'll email you. Надіслати тобі — send you an email, а не send to you an email.

items.pattern: go online · be online · buy / find sth online
items.meaning: on the internet
items.example: My dad buys most of his books **online**.
more: Are you **online**? I want to send you something.
Don't give your address to people you meet **online**.
items.watchOut: В інтернеті — online, без in: I bought it online. Не in online. Можна також on the internet, з the.

items.pattern: What's your email address? · at · dot
items.meaning: the name you use to get emails, like anna@mail.com
items.example: Can you give me your **email address**? I'll send you the photos.
more: My **email address** is tom at fastmail dot com.
I wrote the wrong **email address**, so she didn't get my message.
items.watchOut: @ читається at, крапка — dot: anna@mail.com — anna at mail dot com. Не point і не «собачка».

items.pattern: use / read sth on a mobile device
items.meaning: a small computer you can carry, for example a tablet or an e-reader
items.example: You can read this magazine on any **mobile device**.
more: Our school lets us use **mobile devices** in English lessons.
Grandpa reads books on a **mobile device** now, not on paper.
items.watchOut: Device — наголос на другому складі: /dɪˈvaɪs/. Mobile британці вимовляють /ˈməʊbaɪl/.

items.pattern: a mobile (phone) · on my mobile · a mobile number
items.meaning: a small phone you carry with you
items.example: I left my **mobile** at home, so I couldn't call you.
more: My **mobile** is in my bag.
My **mobile** rang in the middle of the lesson. Oops!
items.watchOut: Британською — mobile або mobile phone, американською — cell phone. Подзвони мені на мобільний — call me on my mobile, з on. Вимова: /ˈməʊbaɪl/.

items.pattern: telephone · phone · on the phone
items.meaning: a machine you use to talk to someone who is far away
items.example: We've got a **telephone** in the hall, but we use our mobiles more.
more: Alexander Graham Bell made the first **telephone**.
Sorry, I can't talk. I'm on the **phone**.
items.watchOut: У розмові частіше кажуть просто phone. Говорити по телефону — be on the phone, а не by the phone.

items.pattern: a phone box · in a phone box
items.meaning: a small box in the street with a phone in it that anyone can use
items.example: There's an old red **phone box** in our village. Now it's a little library.
more: In London, tourists take photos of the red **phone boxes**.
There aren't many **phone boxes** in our town now.
items.watchOut: Американці кажуть phone booth.

items.pattern: make a (phone) call · make calls
items.meaning: use a phone to talk to someone
items.example: I need to **make a phone call**. Can you wait a minute?
more: My dad **makes** a lot of **phone calls** at work.
Can I **make a call** from your phone?
items.watchOut: Дзвонити — make a call, а не do a call.

items.pattern: phone sb · call sb · ring sb
items.meaning: use a phone to talk to someone
items.example: I **phone** my grandma every Sunday.
more: **Phone** me when you get home, OK?
Did anyone **phone** while I was out?
items.watchOut: Дзвонити комусь — phone sb, без to: I phone my friend, а не phone to my friend. Так само call sb, ring sb (британськ.).

items.pattern: a smartphone · on my smartphone
items.meaning: a mobile phone that can go online, take photos and use apps
items.example: My cousin got a new **smartphone** for her birthday.
more: You can take great photos with a **smartphone**.
Grandpa uses his **smartphone** to see us on video.

items.pattern: turn sth off · turn off sth · turn it off
items.meaning: stop a machine working, for example by pressing a button
items.example: I **turn off** the TV when I do my homework.
more: Can you **turn** the lights **off**, please?
Please **turn off** the music. The baby's sleeping.
items.watchOut: Turn it off, а не turn off it: коротке it стоїть посередині. Протилежне — turn on (вмикати). Ще кажуть switch off.

items.pattern: phone number · mobile number · What's your phone number?
items.meaning: the numbers you use to call someone's phone
items.example: My **phone number** is on the back of this card.
more: I know my mum's **mobile number** by heart.
Write your **phone number** on the form, please.
items.watchOut: Нуль у номері британці зазвичай читають oh, дві однакові цифри — double: 0771 — oh double seven one.

items.pattern: answer the phone · answer sb · answer your phone
items.meaning: pick up the phone when it rings and talk
items.example: I called Max three times, but he didn't **answer** his **phone**.
more: My little brother loves to **answer the phone**: 'Hello, who is it?'
Nobody **answered the phone** at the doctor's.
items.watchOut: Відповідати на дзвінок — answer the phone, без on і без to: не answer on the phone.

items.pattern: leave (sb) a voicemail · get a voicemail
items.meaning: a message you speak and leave on someone's phone when they don't answer
items.example: Listen to my **voicemail**. I told you about the party.
more: I always **leave a voicemail** when nobody answers.
My phone says I have a new **voicemail**.
items.watchOut: Залишити повідомлення — leave a voicemail / leave a message, з дієсловом leave.

items.phrase: text sb / send sb a text
items.pattern: text sb · send sb a text (message)
items.meaning: send a short written message from your phone
items.example: **Text** me when you're on the bus, OK?
more: I **sent** my friend **a text** to say happy birthday.
My dad writes very long **text messages**.
items.watchOut: Text — і дієслово (text me), і іменник (a text). Напиши мені — text me, без to: не text to me.

items.pattern: (Hello,) it's + name (+ here)
items.meaning: what you say on the phone to tell someone who you are
items.example: Hi, **it's** Lucy **here**. Is Emma there?
more: Hello, **it's** Mrs Brown **here**, Tom's teacher.
Hi, Grandma, **it's** me!
items.watchOut: По телефону зазвичай кажуть It's Nick (here) або This is Nick. I'm Nick звучить так, ніби ти знайомишся.

items.pattern: Can I / Could I speak to sb, please?
items.meaning: a polite question when you want to talk to a person on the phone
items.example: Hello. **Can I speak to** Mr Green, please?
more: **Can I speak to** your mum, please?
Hi, **could I speak to** Anna?
items.watchOut: Поговорити з кимось — speak to sb (можна й speak with sb). Не say to і не tell to.

items.pattern: at the moment
items.meaning: now
items.example: Sorry, Dad's in the garden **at the moment**.
more: I'm busy **at the moment**. Can I call you back?
We haven't got any milk **at the moment**.
items.watchOut: Зараз — at the moment, з at і the. In the moment — це інше (жити теперішнім), а at moment без the — помилка.

items.pattern: take a message (for sb)
items.meaning: a question: can I write down what you want to say to this person?
items.example: I'm sorry, Mum's at the shops. **Can I take a message**?
more: I **took a message** from your coach. Training is at five tomorrow.
Nobody was at home to **take a message**.
items.watchOut: Той, хто відповідає, — take a message (приймає). Той, хто дзвонить, — leave a message (залишає).

items.pattern: Could you tell him / her I called?
items.meaning: please say to this person that I phoned
items.uk: Передайте, будь ласка, що я дзвонив(ла).
items.example: If Max comes home, **tell him I called**.
more: Did you **tell** Dad **I called**?
I **told her you called**, but she was busy.
items.watchOut: Tell sb — без to: tell him, а не tell to him. Не say him.

items.pattern: call (sb) back · call you back · phone / ring back
items.meaning: phone someone again later, or phone someone who phoned you
items.example: I'm in a shop now. I'll **call** you **back** in ten minutes.
more: Sam phoned. Can you **call** him **back**?
The doctor's busy. Please **call back** after lunch.
items.watchOut: Передзвонити — call back. Him, her, you стоять посередині: call him back, а не call back him.

warmup.explain: В інтернеті — online, без in. Або on the internet, з the.
Дзвонити комусь — phone sb або call sb, без to.
Ноутбук — laptop. Notebook — зошит, flash — спалах.
Поговорити з кимось по телефону — speak to sb. Say і tell тут не підходять.
Зараз — at the moment, з at.
Поштова марка — stamp. Mark — оцінка або пляма, brand — марка товару (Nike, Adidas).

warmup.uk: Чому ти не відповідаєш на дзвінок?
warmup.explain: Answer the phone — без on і без to.
Передзвонити — call back: спочатку call, потім back.

Don't forget to write the ___ at the top: 3rd May.

B.q: Mum's ___ is in her bag. She takes it to work every day.
B.explain: Комп'ютер, який носять у сумці, — laptop.

B.q: Use the ___ to click on the picture.
I don't know her phone number, but I know her ___ address.

C.q: I can't talk now. I'll ___ you after school.
C.explain: Написати повідомлення — text sb. Send потребує, що саме: send you a text.

C.q: It's very late. ___ the computer and go to sleep.
C.explain: Перед сном комп'ютер вимикають — turn off.

C.q: I've got a new ___. Let me listen to it.
C.explain: Голосове повідомлення, яке можна прослухати, — voicemail.

D.q: 'Hello?' 'Hi, ___ Max here. Is Tom at home?'
D.explain: По телефону кажуть It's Max here.

D.q: 'Tom isn't at home. Can I take a ___?' 'Yes, please.'
D.explain: Прийняти повідомлення для когось — take a message.

D.q: I'm busy now. I'll call you ___ in an hour.

example.title: A card for Grandma
example.uk:
У п'ятницю в бабусі був день народження. У понеділок я написала їй листа й поклала його в конверт. Потім я наклеїла марку й відправила його.

У п'ятницю ввечері я подзвонила їй, але вона не відповіла. Тож я залишила голосове повідомлення.

Пізніше задзвонив наш телефон. «Привіт, це дідусь. Бабуся зараз у саду. Вона отримала твого листа й дуже рада! Вона тобі передзвонить».

О восьмій бабуся надіслала мені повідомлення: «Дякую! Це найкращий подарунок!»
example.en:
On Friday it was Grandma's birthday. On Monday I wrote her a [[letter|a1]] and put it in an [[envelope|a4]]. Then I put a [[stamp|a5]] on it and [[posted|a7]] it.

On Friday evening I [[phoned|c6]] her, but she didn't [[answer|c10]]. So I left a [[voicemail|c11]].

Later our phone rang. 'Hi, [[it's Grandpa here|d1]]. Grandma is in the garden [[at the moment|d3]]. She got your letter, and she's very happy! She'll [[call you back|d6]].'

At eight o'clock Grandma [[sent me a text|c12]]: 'Thank you! It's the best present!'
